digest.component_or_area: Rebar reconciler binding store and GET rotation persistence
propositions: Implement a new rotation module that loads/saves GET rotation state to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json while dual-writing to legacy inline fields during rollout to support mixed-version deployments

Rotation state must read max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) for each Jira key and write both representations through all BindingStore.save() paths (end-of-pass, write-ahead, recovery, retirement)
outbound_differ.py must remain at or below 800 lines after extracting outbound wrappers and wiring shared rotation accessors
git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE constant and reconcile_helpers.py staging logic must ensure both rotated files land in a single local commit without git add -A
Interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequences must produce identical rotation order as all-new sequences via proper dual-write implementation
reconcile-check CLI read-only invocations must not create or modify get_rotation.json and must leave git status clean
